name: Patero
decision_note: Prague private investment holding of the five Logio founders investing their own money in tech startups (e.g. Flowlance pre-seed, Nov 2024) and building its own (Inventoro) - a private investor, outside the VC pilot type.

evidence.quote: Skupinu Patero založila, jak napovídá i název, pětice kamarádů, David Svatoš, Tomáš Formánek, Martin Kment, Jan Jirovec a Marek Šucha, kteří společně od roku 2004 budovali logistickou firmu Logio a v rámci Patera teď investují do nadějných startupů.
Kromě Czech Founders VC se na ni složil i brněnský fond Purple Ventures, skupina Patero a andělský investor Miroslav Uďan, zakladatel Shoptetu a nedávno ukončeného startupu Out of Dark .

analyst_notes: Patero s.r.o. (IČO 03928446, Evropská, Praha 6) is owned by the five Logio founders (Svatoš, Formánek, Kment, Jirovec, Šucha) per ARES; CzechCrunch calls it a holding / investment group that invests in startups (Stories - sold to Workday, Yieldigo, Shipvio, Wereldo, Flowpay EUR 500k in 2021) and incubated its own Inventoro (sold to Cin7, 2024). No fund vehicle, external LPs or own website could be found (patero.cz did not respond; patero.com returned a certificate error), so it is typed private_investor (principals' own capital) and excluded S1. Activity in window: Flowlance (Czech) EUR 500k pre-seed with Czech Founders VC, Purple Ventures and Miroslav Uďan (amount in the same sentence's preceding clause; CzechCrunch 2024-11-28, date = article date). Note: quote e2 keeps the page's space before the final full stop.
